summary: The market data pool opens a second Kite connection when the first is full (one instrument each here): TCS is subscribed on connection 2, its quote comes from there, and INFY's still comes from connection 1.

notes: A quote packet carries no trade time; the web and the desktop both send the time the packet was received as ltt.

The pool is the session's (broker_runtime::pool_limits: Kite's three connections) with one instrument per connection for the case; the web's pool opens its next connection the same way (websocket_proxy/connection_manager.py), and its adapter decodes each connection's packets alike.
